added.member: UI classes skew-*, wipe transitions, animate-shake, animate-flash, animate-recoil
added.summary: A UI element can skew (skew-x-*, skew-y-*) and both a skew and a radial image wipe transition between styles; animate-shake, animate-flash and animate-recoil are new keyframe presets, and the preset animations take their durations from the theme's duration tokens (ready-pulse, damage, flash).
A theme or pack names scale, opacity and stroke-width tokens (scale-press, opacity-flash, stroke-arc …) that classes read like its other tokens.

fixed.summary: A press, hover or drop on a transformed (moved, scaled, rotated or skewed) element lands where the element is drawn.

fixed: A removed UI element frees its slot and an inline style its cache entry, so a screen that mounts and unmounts many nodes no longer grows memory.
Colour emoji draw in their colours in UI text.
